title: M/s Babu Jagadish Singh Cold Storage Pvt. Ltd. v. State of U.P.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Dilip Gupta, J.; Pankaj Bhatia, J.
disposition: Listed July 2020; costs for delayed counter; merits open
headnote: Interlocutory listing of a 2009 electricity writ. After eleven years without a counter affidavit, three weeks were granted on costs of Rs 5,000 recoverable from the Executive Engineer. The counter was to disclose the status of the final report and why the proceedings might not be dropped under the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. No merits decided.
facts: M/s Babu Jagadish Singh Cold Storage Pvt. Ltd. filed Writ-C No. 24039 of 2009 against the State of U.P. and electricity officials. After a 2009 illness-slip adjournment the petition remained without a counter. In January 2020 the Court noted a change of electricity counsel and directed service. On 28 January 2020 three weeks were allowed for a counter on costs of Rs 5,000, recoverable from the Executive Engineer, to address the final report and why proceedings might not be dropped under the 2005 Supply Code. The cause was then listed for July 2020.

holding_units.holding: The writ was not decided on merits. After noting that the electricity department had not filed a counter affidavit for eleven years, the Court granted three weeks and no more, on payment of Rs 5,000 recoverable from the Executive Engineer, and directed that the counter disclose the status of the final report and why the proceedings may not be dropped in terms of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. On joint request the matter was listed for July 2020.

not_decided.point: Whether the electricity proceedings should be dropped under the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005
not_decided.note: The Court only directed the licensee to address this in the counter affidavit.
